svg.title: Option A — normal critical delivery via push

g.text: Option A — normal critical delivery via push
BEGIN; unique inbox; notification; outbox; COMMIT
202 means durable acceptance, not device delivery.
create PUSH attempt + deadline t0+8s + command outbox
Claim attempt; verify current state / preference version
cancel unsent future attempts; outbox; COMMIT
App receipt is delivery evidence; opening / reading is separate.
Crash after COMMIT or duplicate publication is recovered by outbox + inbox.
